itens.resposta: No. Lumi uses cloud processing to generate AI renders, so an internet connection is required during use.

itens.pergunta: Do I need a powerful graphics card?
itens.resposta: No. All the heavy processing happens on our servers. Your computer just needs to run SketchUp normally.

itens.pergunta: Can I use it for commercial projects?
itens.resposta: Yes. All Lumi licenses, including the monthly plan, allow unlimited use in commercial and client projects.
The macOS version is in development and coming soon. Lumi is currently available for Windows only.
We offer a 7-day guarantee on all plans. If Lumi doesn't meet your expectations, we refund 100% of the amount paid.
